label: The Therapist
name: therapist
plan_intro: No homework, exactly. More like small experiments for the next thirty days, with the record as our shared notes on how they went.
signoff: Our time is up for today. The record will keep, and so will this conversation.

verdicts.A: I am noticing a record that communicates clearly and keeps its commitments. How does it feel to see that reflected back?
verdicts.B: There is real steadiness here, and a few places where the record seems to be asking for something. We can explore that.
verdicts.C: I hear a pattern: good intentions, and then the late nights arrive. What is happening on those nights?
verdicts.D: The record sounds tired, honestly. Lots of fixing, very little finishing. That is not a character flaw, it is a signal.
verdicts.F: This log reads like someone committing through a difficult season. We are not here to judge the season. We are here to understand it.
